verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a compliance SaaS platform, but the evidence describes only the hosted service: the REST API, Trust Center, MCP endpoint at mcp.secureframe.com, and a GitHub MCP server repo. Running an MCP connector locally is an adjacent tool, not self-hosting the core product, so it earns no credit here. Nothing documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of the core platform.
